narrator.role: Dry, sarcastic compliance officer — seen it all

segments.text: Friday. Three forty-five. You were about to leave.
Then the email arrives. HKEX has published a rule amendment. Effective next week.
Your team needs to file the regulatory impact assessment before the e-Filing system locks at four PM.
Fifteen minutes. That's all you've got.
e-Filing system closing in fifteen minutes. All incomplete submissions will be discarded.
The template is fragmented. The approval chain is broken. And someone — I won't name names — shredded the reference circular.
Half the time gone. If you haven't found the Director's signature yet, I'd start worrying.
Submission received. Reference number generated. Have a good weekend.
Filed. On time. On a Friday.
The regulator won't thank you. Your manager won't notice. But you know what you did.
Now close your laptop and go home.
Session expired. Submission discarded. Please contact your Compliance Officer.
The system locks. The screen goes dark.
Somewhere in Central, a regulator shakes their head. Monday is going to be unpleasant.
Maybe next time, start before three forty-five.
